narrationTexts: I'll start by exploring the repository structure.
finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** Out of 380 commits, 12 matter to users.

Three are breaking. The `v1` export route is gone. An expired token now returns 401, not 403. The latency histogram units were wrong and now are right, so dashboards shift. One feature: webhook retries with backoff. The rest are fixes. The best one is `fix(db)`, which stopped logging whole request bodies.

Two calls to check. Seven `stop re-exporting the internal error types` commits touch module files, never an entry file. I read those as internal and left them out. Five `docs: note the minimum node version` commits plus CI on Node 22 hint at a floor bump, but no `engines` change appears.

Next: confirm those two, then fix the date if you cut on a different day.
